payout_quote: Your developer starts with a project—we deal with a contract, monthly payouts, and what not
steps: Apply online on lemon.io with your portfolio and experience.
Pass Lemon.io's multi-stage vetting: background check, technical skills assessment, test assignment, and live interview (only a small fraction of applicants pass).
Get listed in the vetted developer pool.
Receive curated client matches (typically within 24-48 hours of a client request) and interview with clients.
Start the project; Lemon.io handles the contract and monthly payouts.
catches: Highly selective vetting — most applicants are rejected and earn nothing for the hours spent applying.
Rates are transparent but negotiated per engagement; nothing is guaranteed until a client hires you.
Work is client-dependent: engagements are typically 20-40 hrs/week project commitments, not casual micro-gigs.
The developer pool skews toward European and Latin American developers (per Lemon.io's own blog) — competition is experienced.
biggest_catch: Most applicants never earn anything: the multi-stage vetting rejects the large majority, and even accepted developers only earn when a client picks them.
eligibility: Experienced developers able to pass a four-step vetting process (technical + English communication).
timing: Matching typically within 24-48 hours of a client request once you are vetted; payouts monthly.

c1.evidence: Lemon.io's own site states the mechanism: 'Get 2-3 expertly matched candidates within 24-48 hours' for clients and 'Your developer starts with a project—we deal with a contract, monthly payouts, and what not' for developers.

c2.evidence: Official terms publish no fixed developer pay range — rates are per-engagement; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: apply, multi-stage vetting, pool listing, matching, interview, project start.

c4.evidence: Applying and vetting are free for developers; no upfront fee documented.

s1.note: Eligibility is experienced developers who can pass vetting in English.
